title: There Is An Open Source For That
brief: A directory of open-source alternatives to popular software. The description is inferred from the site's name; unverified from the message.
caveat: The description is inferred from the site's name; unverified from the message.
details: There Is An Open Source For That is a curated directory of 193 open-source alternatives to popular proprietary tools — Supabase for Firebase, Excalidraw for Miro, AppFlowy for Notion, Vaultwarden for 1Password, and similar swaps. Each listing notes the license model (truly open source, open core, or source-available) and what it replaces, plus a weekly Thursday newsletter that evidence-checks two alternatives with who should use them, the biggest catch, and the easiest way to try them.
